SPRING_DATASOURCE_PASSWORD: postgres
      SPRING_SECURITY_OAUTH2_RESOURCESERVER_JWT_ISSUER_URI: ${SPRING_SECURITY_OAUTH2_RESOURCESERVER_JWT_ISSUER_URI}
      SPRING_SECURITY_OAUTH2_RESOURCESERVER_JWT_JWK_SET_URI: ${SPRING_SECURITY_OAUTH2_RESOURCESERVER_JWT_JWK_SET_URI}
      KEYCLOAK_MANAGEMENT_URL: ${KEYCLOAK_MANAGEMENT_URL}
      APP_CORS_URLS: ${APP_CORS_URLS}
      AWS_S3_ENDPOINT: ${AWS_S3_ENDPOINT}
      AWS_S3_FORCEPATHSTYLE: "true"
      SWCODE_MEILISEARCH_URL: ${SWCODE_MEILISEARCH_URL}
      IMGPROXY_URL: ${IMGPROXY_URL}
      URBO_NOTIFICATION_SENDINBLUE_APIURL: ${URBO_NOTIFICATION_SENDINBLUE_APIURL}
      URBO_SURVEY_LIMESURVEY_BASE_URL: ${URBO_SURVEY_LIMESURVEY_BASE_URL}
      URBO_CMS_ACCESSIBILITY_SUBMISSIONS_URL: ${URBO_CMS_ACCESSIBILITY_SUBMISSIONS_URL}
      URBO_CMS_PARTICIPATION_STATEMENTS_URL: ${URBO_CMS_PARTICIPATION_STATEMENTS_URL}
      URBO_CMS_CHANGE_REQUESTS_URL: ${URBO_CMS_CHANGE_REQUESTS_URL}

  # Runs psql against the stack's existing Postgres and exits. Overriding the entrypoint keeps the
  # image's own docker-entrypoint.sh out of it, so this never starts a second Postgres server.
  limesurvey-db-init:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    profiles: ["limesurvey"]
    depends_on:
      urbo-backend-postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
    volumes:
      - ./limesurvey/create-limesurvey-database.sh:/create-limesurvey-database.sh:ro
    entrypoint: [ "/bin/sh", "/create-limesurvey-database.sh" ]
    environment:
      PGHOST: urbo-backend-postgres
      PGPORT: "5432"
      PGDATABASE: postgres
      PGUSER: postgres
      PGPASSWORD: postgres
      LIMESURVEY_DB_NAME: limesurvey
    restart: "no"
    labels:
      io.swcode.urbo.instance: ${URBO_INSTANCE}

  limesurvey:
    image: martialblog/limesurvey:6-apache
    profiles: ["limesurvey"]
    depends_on:
      limesurvey-db-init:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
    volumes:
      # A named volume, not a bind mount: Docker seeds it from the image, so LimeSurvey finds the
      # themes and generated files it ships with. A bind mount would start out empty and break it.
      - urbo-limesurvey-uploads:/var/www/html/upload
      - ./limesurvey/enable-remote-control.php:/enable-remote-control.php:ro
      - ./limesurvey/import-sample-surveys.sh:/import-sample-surveys.sh:ro
      - ./limesurvey/sample-surveys:/sample-surveys:ro
    # The image entrypoint still runs first and provisions the schema; this only replaces its
    # `apache2-foreground` command, so the API is switched on and the sample surveys are imported
    # before the site serves its first request. Separated by `;` rather than `&&` on purpose: a
    # seeding problem is a nuisance, not a reason to leave the developer without LimeSurvey at all,
    # and each script reports its own errors.
    command: [ "sh", "-c", "php /enable-remote-control.php; sh /import-sample-surveys.sh; exec apache2-foreground" ]
    environment:
      DB_TYPE: pgsql
      DB_HOST: urbo-backend-postgres
      DB_PORT: "5432"
      DB_NAME: limesurvey
      # The image defaults to this, but only as a shell variable its entrypoint never exports.
      # enable-remote-control.php needs to see the same prefix, so it is set explicitly here.
      DB_TABLE_PREFIX: lime_
      DB_USERNAME: postgres
      DB_PASSWORD: postgres
      ADMIN_USER: admin
      ADMIN_NAME: Urbo Admin
      ADMIN_EMAIL: test@test.de
      ADMIN_PASSWORD: admin
      PUBLIC_URL: ${LIMESURVEY_PUBLIC_URL}
      # No ENCRYPT_* keys on purpose. LimeSurvey then generates a throwaway security.php per
      # container, which is fine for dev: recreating the container makes previously encrypted
      # participant data unreadable, and nothing here is worth keeping.
    restart: unless-stopped
    networks:
      default:
        aliases:
          - limesurvey.${URBO_INSTANCE}.internal
    labels:
      io.swcode.urbo.instance: ${URBO_INSTANCE}

  sample-images:
    image: nginx:alpine
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - ./nginx/nginx.conf:/etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf:ro
      - ./sample-data/images:/usr/share/nginx/sample-images:ro
    networks:
      default:
        aliases:
          - sample-images.${URBO_INSTANCE}.internal
    labels:
      io.swcode.urbo.instance: ${URBO_INSTANCE}

  sample-data-loader:
    image: python:3.12-alpine
    profiles: ["seed"]
    depends_on:
      spring-app:
        condition: service_healthy
